title: Passive and reflexive
summary: Say what was done without saying who did it, with the passive (*guruldy, dokaldy, arassalandy*), state rules and ask the way with the passive and no subject (*Bu ýerde çilim çekilmeýär*, *Nädip barylýar?*), talk about washing and dressing with the reflexive (*ýuwunmak, geýinmek, taýýarlanmak*), and say **myself** and **my own** with *öz* (*özüm, öz öýüm*).
canDo: Say when and where something was built, made or woven
Understand and state simple rules: no smoking, no swimming, shoes off
Ask how to get somewhere or how something is done
Talk about getting washed, dressed and ready
Say that you did something yourself, or for yourself
